pr_body:
## Summary

Adds the Claude-specific ACP discovery, setup, runtime identity, launch metadata, capability metadata, and diagnostics adapter on top of the ACP Foundation branch. Reuses existing Windows/WSL external-agent placement helpers without changing legacy Claude stream-json or Codex behavior.

## Validation

Authoring subtask only. Heavy Cargo, Windows, and Visual Validation are intentionally deferred to final ACP integration.
